datalist.name: Charge Identity
datalist.desc: Identities that have Base Attack Skills that apply, gain, or consume Charge or Unique Charge

datalist.name: Inertia of Drifting
datalist.desc:
- Max Count: 20
- Unique Charge
- Interacts the same way as normal Charge does to effects that raise or reduce Charge Potency and Count
- Turn End: Lose 1 Count

<color=#1aece7>Cumulative Count consumed: {2}</color>
datalist.flavor: Those who are carried by the tide like buoys may not be able to change the flow of things, but they can still bolster the tide and commit to their acts within.

datalist.name: Mark of Shearing
datalist.desc:
- Max Stack: 4
- When a target that has this effect is defeated, the unit that inflicted this effect heals 5 SP and gains 1 Offense Level Up next turn (3 times per turn)
datalist.flavor: A cutting mark used to trim fabric and other materials to the required measurements.

datalist.name: Blossom Scissors
datalist.desc:
- Max Stack: 2
- Deal +7% damage for every Stack
datalist.flavor: The scissors used to sever the primordial materials produced underground are larger and more extraordinary still. These scissors have cut and recut the very first cloth ever woven. That flowers should bloom from them is only natural, for they have always cut things at their very roots.

datalist.name: Duality
datalist.desc:
Skills can target allied Identities
Upon auto-targeting Skills, or in Regular Encounters, prioritize the ally with the earliest Deployment Order
- If target is an ally, the attack does not hit, and does not trigger Defense Skills (including Clashable Defense Skills)
If target is an ally, activate this Skill at Combat Start

datalist.name: Duality
datalist.desc:
Skills can target allies
Upon auto-targeting Skills, or in Regular Encounters, target random allies
- If target is an ally, the attack does not hit, and does not trigger Defense Skills (including Clashable Defense Skills)
If target is an ally, activate this Skill at Combat Start

datalist.name: Second is Welcome-snipping
datalist.desc:
- Max Stack: 1
- Offense Level +3, Defense Level +3
- On Skill Use, heal 5 SP if this unit is a Charge Identity (once per turn)
- On Base Skill Hit, deal Slash damage equal to 5% of each Coin's final damage
- Expires at Turn End
datalist.flavor: A pair of scissors becomes one through two, and makes two of what was one.
